De Other Side (also spelled as Da Other Side and The Other Side) is Bwonsamdi's pocket dimension in the Shadowlands. Though it is a realm of its own, it has a physical entrance in Ardenweald. Bwonsamdi brings the spirits of any who worship him into his realm. The realm of death is his alone and Bwonsamdi guards spirits well, if a life ends and Bwonsamdi is that someone's friend, then that spirit Bwonsamdi will surely guide, "Come on through to de other side." Brokers are not permitted to visit and are generally not accepted as trade partners according to members of Cartel Ta, but Bwonsamdi has made at least one exception.

The Outer Ring connects the four quarters of Naxxramas. Depending on which quarter you are in, you will encounter enemies ranging from spiders to death knights. Shades patrol the Outer Ring, constantly making a habit of appearing out of nowhere. Though the Outer Ring connects each quarter, it appears the ends are blocked off by a wall. This is to prevent raids from only having to clear one quarter to access other quarters 'end' bosses. However, underneath the walls are tunnels that one can swim through to access the outer ring of another quarter. 'End' bosses however, will be blocked off unless the other bosses in their respective quarters are cleared.

The Outriggers, or Stormriggers, are an organization of Kul Tiran monster hunters based in Tiragarde Sound. The group has dedicated itself to defending Kul Tiras and the Sound from external threats that might emerge, though they specialize in fighting monsters and creatures from the sea, centered around Anglepoint Bay. The group maintains a base at Krakenbane Cove. Eventually, as the Fourth War progressed, the Outriggers would accept an offer to crew a new flagship constructed specifically for King Anduin Wrynn, with Rosaline Madison acting as first mate on board.

Ottuks are a species of large, tusked otters native to the Dragon Isles. They act as hunting companions and mounts of the tuskarr of the Isles, who regard them not as pets, but as friends and family members. Hunters of the Uktulut tribe hold the bond between a tuskarr and their ottuk to be sacred. Ottuks can be tamed as hunter pets after completing While the Iron Is Hot with any character on the same account. They're part of the rodent family.
__NOTOC__ Outcast's Alcove is located on the western coast of the Waking Shores. It is the home of Tarjin the Blind and his elemental servants.
Overengineered Sleeve Extenders are created by Dragon Isles Engineering (50); taught by Schematic: Overengineered Sleeve Extenders.
__NOTOC__ Overcharged Overclocker is a crafted finishing crafting reagent made with and used exclusively in Dragon Isles Engineering; taught by Schematic: Overcharged Overclocker.
Ottuk Pups are ottuks located on Morqut Islet in the Forbidden Reach. They can be seen with Tuskarr Children.

Ottuk Taming allows a hunter to tame ottuks. This is an account-wide unlock, earned by reaching Renown level 11 with the Iskaara Tuskarr and then completing the "Chieftain's Duty" questline, which begins with A Lost Tribe and ends with While the Iron Is Hot. Though it only benefits hunters, it can be unlocked with a character of any class.
